fields.label: Particulars / Line Name (Print)
fields.description: Customer-facing line name on the quote. Change freely (e.g. BIS Consultancy Fee).

fields.label: Cost Component
fields.description: Any name — Consulting Charges, Government Fees, or your own label.

fields.label: Charges Display (Print)
fields.description: Optional print text e.g. ₹ 25,000/- per Test Report (overrides Amount on print)

fields.label: Payment Destination
fields.options:
Payable to Instacertify
Payable Directly to Government
Payable Directly to Laboratory
Payable to Third Party
fields.description: Payable to Instacertify = counted revenue. Other destinations auto-mark Do Not Count as Revenue.

fields.label: Do Not Count as Revenue
fields.description: Tick = pass-through (shown to customer but paid to govt/lab/third party). Unticked = counted Instacertify revenue.
